deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

description.description: An optional description of this resource.

gateway_ip_version.description: The IP family of the gateway IPs for the HA-VPN gateway interfaces. If not specified, IPV4 will be used. Default value: "IPV4" Possible values: ["IPV4", "IPV6"]

labels.description:
Labels for this resource. These can only be added or modified by the setLabels method.
Each label key/value pair must comply with RFC1035. Label values may be empty.


**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.

name.description:
Name of the resource. Provided by the client when the resource is
created. The name must be 1-63 characters long, and comply with
RFC1035.  Specifically, the name must be 1-63 characters long and
match the regular expression '[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?' which means
the first character must be a lowercase letter, and all following
characters must be a dash, lowercase letter, or digit, except the last
character, which cannot be a dash.

network.description: The network this VPN gateway is accepting traffic for.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

region.description: The region this gateway should sit in.
region.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

stack_type.description:
The stack type for this VPN gateway to identify the IP protocols that are enabled.
If not specified, IPV4_ONLY will be used. Default value: "IPV4_ONLY" Possible values: ["IPV4_ONLY", "IPV4_IPV6", "IPV6_ONLY"]

params.description: Additional params passed with the request, but not persisted as part of resource payload

params.resource_manager_tags.description:
Resource manager tags to be bound to the HaVpnGateway. Tag keys and values have the
same definition as resource manager tags. Keys must be in the format tagKeys/{tag_key_id},
and values are in the format tagValues/456.

vpn_interfaces.description: A list of interfaces on this VPN gateway.

vpn_interfaces.id.description: The numeric ID of this VPN gateway interface.

vpn_interfaces.interconnect_attachment.description:
URL of the interconnect attachment resource. When the value
of this field is present, the VPN Gateway will be used for
IPsec-encrypted Cloud Interconnect; all Egress or Ingress
traffic for this VPN Gateway interface will go through the
specified interconnect attachment resource.

Not currently available publicly.
